title: St Anton Full Catalog Curation - normalized model migration
summary: Migrates PR #11 onto the normalized Snowcast catalog. Facts are assigned to explicit regions, stay destinations, stay bases, ski areas, access edges, terrain domains, pass products, and rental facts. Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Reviewed St. Anton's new ski-area and stay-base facts against official Ski Arlberg, tourism-association, municipal, and OSM sources. Added the dedicated snowpark, the complete marked ski-route inventory, the 38 lifts in the official St. Anton-St. Christoph-Stuben inventory, a stable winter piste map, the published Winter 2026/27 season, destination-defining apres, village elevation and character, and a source-backed Galzigbahn access distance while retaining unsupported piste-kilometre, snowmaking, glacier, and public night-skiing values as unknown.

ranking_impact_summary: Ranking-relevant facts now attach to the normalized ski-area, stay-base, and access-edge owners; Search V3 scoring policy is unchanged.
unresolved_caveats: Ski Arlberg publishes 300 km of runs and 85 lifts for the linked Arlberg domain; these metrics are not copied to the local St Anton ski_area because linked member sectors are outside the modeled child weather unit.
No child-scoped official piste difficulty-km split was found for the St Anton weather unit.
Official 2026/27 winter ticket tariffs are not published yet; representative pass prices use the official Winter 2025/26 ticket guide.
Accommodation and rental price ranges remain product-curated estimates until a provider sampling policy is reviewed.

Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Official Ski Arlberg material confirms modern infrastructure and snowmaking history but does not establish current snowmaking availability or coverage for the modeled St. Anton-St. Christoph-Stuben area.
Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: The evening ski show is a demonstration rather than public night skiing, so conventional night-skiing availability remains unknown.

Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: The 19-route count comes from the operator's complete St. Anton-St. Christoph-Stuben live inventory and includes entries classified as ski route or extreme ski route.
